preconditions.description: The number of favourite integers t must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in x_i)
preconditions.description: Each favourite integer x_i must be between 1 and 10^18.
The number of favourite integers provided must match t.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(x in possible_pips for x in x_i) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if any of the favourite integers can be achieved as visible pips, otherwise output 'NO'.
